routes.summary: I-75 N / I-10 W Lafayette → I-10 W Kerrville → I-10 W Las Cruces → I-10 / US-93 Kingman → I-15 / Provo Canyon Sunday → 900 Bitner Road, Apartment E17, Park City, UT 84098
routes.winterNotes: The southern route stays under 5,000 feet until Sunday. Sunday climbs I-15 to its 6,600-foot summit north of Beaver, then Provo Canyon instead of Parleys. If I-15 north of Cedar City has snow, stay in St. George. The pin is Apartment E17, not the town centroid.
